title: China export controls on gallium and germanium
description: China's MOFCOM announced export licensing on gallium and germanium (effective Aug 1 2023), restricting semiconductor and defense feedstock and tightening supply of two metals it dominates globally.

title: China export controls on graphite
description: China's MOFCOM announced export permits for synthetic and natural flake graphite (effective Dec 1 2023), squeezing the anode-material supply chain for EV and grid batteries where China refines the bulk of global graphite.

title: China bans export of rare-earth processing and magnet technology
description: China banned export of technology to extract, separate and produce rare-earth metals and permanent magnets, extending leverage from raw materials to the processing know-how behind global rare-earth supply.

title: China export controls on antimony
description: China's MOFCOM imposed export licensing on antimony and related items (effective Sep 15 2024), tightening supply of a metal critical to flame retardants, ammunition and solar glass where China holds ~48% of mine output.

title: China bans gallium germanium antimony exports to the US
description: China's MOFCOM banned exports of gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard materials to the United States, its first outright export ban explicitly targeting the US semiconductor and defense supply chain.

title: China export controls on seven rare earths and magnets
description: China imposed case-by-case export licensing on seven medium/heavy rare earths (incl. dysprosium, terbium) and permanent magnets, choking magnet supply to Western auto, defense and energy manufacturers.

title: China export controls on tungsten tellurium bismuth indium molybdenum
description: In retaliation for new US tariffs, China imposed export licensing on five critical metals - tungsten, tellurium, bismuth, indium and molybdenum - key to defense, semiconductors and solar.

title: US sweeping export controls on advanced chips to China
description: US BIS imposed broad controls on advanced-computing chips, chipmaking equipment and a foreign-direct-product rule for China, aiming to cut off AI/supercomputing chip supply.

title: US Section 301 tariff hikes on Chinese EVs batteries solar minerals
description: USTR finalized Section 301 tariff increases on Chinese EVs (to 100%), batteries, solar cells, graphite and magnets, raising input costs across the clean-energy commodity chain.

title: China retaliatory tariffs on 75bn US goods including crude oil
description: China announced 5-10% tariffs on $75bn of US goods (effective Sep/Dec 2019) covering crude oil for the first time, directly taxing US crude flows to China.

title: China live-fire drills encircle Taiwan after Pelosi visit
description: China launched unprecedented live-fire drills and missile launches encircling Taiwan, closing Taiwan Strait shipping zones and raising perceived risk to TSMC output and East Asian trade.

title: Niger uranium coup blocks Orano exports
description: Coup deposing President Bazoum interrupted reagent imports to SOMAIR and closed the Niger-Benin border, blocking uranium concentrate exports from the world's 7th-largest producer.

title: Guinea bauxite coup shuts borders
description: Military coup deposing President Conde suspended the constitution and shut borders in the world's 2nd-largest bauxite producer, threatening the ore feedstock for aluminium smelting.

title: Indonesia nickel ore export ban brought forward to 2020
description: The world's largest nickel ore producer announced a ban on all nickel ore exports effective 1 January 2020, two years early, choking off ore feedstock to overseas smelters.

title: Chile announces plan to nationalize lithium
description: President Boric announced a state-controlled model requiring the state to hold 50.01% of lithium joint ventures in the world's 2nd-largest lithium producer, raising future supply and investment risk.

title: Las Bambas copper mine suspends operations amid protests
description: MMG suspended output at Peru's Las Bambas after community members occupied the property, halting a mine supplying about 2% of global copper.

title: Panama orders closure of Cobre Panama copper mine
description: After the Supreme Court ruled First Quantum's contract unconstitutional, Panama ordered closure of Cobre Panama, removing roughly 1.5% of global copper mine supply.

title: Black Sea Grain Initiative signed reopening Ukraine exports
description: Russia, Ukraine, Turkey and the UN signed the Black Sea Grain Initiative, reopening safe corridors from Odesa-area ports and easing the wheat and corn supply squeeze.

title: Russia terminates Black Sea grain deal
description: Russia withdrew from the Black Sea Grain Initiative, again closing safe passage for Ukrainian grain and tightening global wheat and corn supply.

title: US and UK ban Russian aluminium copper nickel from exchanges
description: Coordinated US-UK prohibitions barred Russian-origin aluminium, copper and nickel from the LME and CME, fragmenting exchange-deliverable metal supply.

title: DRC suspends all cobalt exports
description: ARECOMS imposed a four-month suspension on all cobalt exports from the DRC, source of about 70% of world cobalt, to curb oversupply and defend prices.

title: Kachin rebels seize Myanmar rare-earth mining hub
description: The Kachin Independence Army seized heavy rare-earth mining towns supplying most of China's dysprosium and terbium feedstock, collapsing cross-border shipments.

title: Indonesia bans palm oil exports
description: The world's largest palm oil producer banned crude palm oil and refined product exports to curb domestic cooking-oil prices, shocking the global edible-oils supply.

title: Kazakhstan unrest disrupts Tengiz oil output
description: Nationwide unrest over fuel prices led Chevron to cut output at the giant Tengiz oil field, in a country also supplying about 40% of world uranium.

title: US Section 232 steel and aluminium tariffs
description: Trump signed proclamations imposing 25% steel and 10% aluminium tariffs, raising input costs across industrial-metals and energy-infrastructure supply chains.

title: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism takes effect
description: The EU CBAM transitional phase began, applying an embedded-emissions reporting regime to imported steel, aluminium and cement, raising the landed cost of carbon-intensive commodities.

title: US 2024 presidential election (Trump win)
description: Trump's election win shifted the oil outlook via expected pro-supply domestic production alongside tighter Iran/Venezuela sanctions and tariff policy.

title: US tariffs on Canada Mexico China with energy carve-out
description: Trump ordered 25% tariffs on Canada/Mexico (10% on Canadian energy) and 10% on China, directly taxing cross-border crude and refined-product flows into US refineries.

title: US restores maximum-pressure campaign on Iran
description: Trump signed a memorandum directing agencies to drive Iranian oil exports toward zero, aiming to tighten global crude supply.

title: US revokes Chevron Venezuela oil license
description: Trump revoked Chevron's license to operate in Venezuela, threatening to pull roughly a quarter of Venezuela's ~1 mbd output off the market.

title: US 25pct secondary tariff on buyers of Venezuelan oil
description: Trump signed an order allowing 25% tariffs on any country importing Venezuelan crude, threatening Venezuela's exports to China and India.

title: Trump Liberation Day reciprocal tariffs
description: Trump signed an order imposing a 10% baseline plus steep reciprocal tariffs on major partners, raising global recession/demand-destruction fears that weigh on oil demand.

title: OPEC+ second consecutive 411k bpd output hike for June
description: OPEC+ agreed a second straight 411k bpd increase for June, accelerating the supply return and pushing prices toward four-year lows.

title: US-China Geneva tariff truce
description: The US and China agreed to slash tariffs for 90 days, easing recession fears and supporting oil demand expectations.

title: Trump threatens 100pct secondary tariffs on Russian oil buyers
description: Trump threatened 100% secondary tariffs on countries buying Russian energy within 50 days, threatening Russian crude flows to India and China.
